name: First-time-right creative QA (run before delivering)
rule: Do not deliver an ad package until every applicable item is PASS or N/A with reason.

gates.ask: Platform, niche, offer, funnel, production tier, and CTA are explicit?
gates.fail_if: Any of those are guessed without stating assumptions

gates.ask: Primary pattern id + challenger id retrieved from the database?
gates.fail_if: Freewheeled style with no pattern id

gates.ask: One job-to-be-done stated in one sentence?
Product sheet filled or missing refs explicitly requested; character sheet filled if talent; style lock stated?
gates.fail_if: Generated without product/character consistency system or silently skipped sheets

gates.ask: 0–3s works muted (text or pure visual) and does not open on logo?
gates.fail_if: Logo-first or abstract brand talk in first 3s
Trend claimed but format not signaled

gates.ask: Script has timecodes matching a flow from flows/library.json?
All proof is user-provided or marked [PLACEHOLDER]?
Exactly one primary CTA in the cut?
gates.fail_if: Shop + follow + comment keyword + link spam together

gates.ask: Audio, faces, footage rights called out for paid use?
gates.fail_if: Assumes trending sound is free for ads

gates.ask: AI disclosure & rights block filled (synthetic media flags, likeness policy, paid-safe decision)?
gates.fail_if: Silent on synthetic media or celebrity/deepfake risk

gates.ask: All deliverables in the pattern output_contract present?
Self-critique section present: all rubric dims scored, 2–3 niche/platform failure modes listed, A/B/C variants that attack those failures?
gates.fail_if: Delivered first draft without scored critique or concrete variants

gates.ask: If user asked viral AND quality: both postures delivered with same JTBD?
gates.fail_if: Only one track when both requested

gates.ask: Aspect ratio, caption style, length, and disclosure fit the platform?
gates.fail_if: 16:9 letterbox dumped into TikTok without vertical cut; missing required synthetic-media label when applicable

dimensions.name: Thumb-stop (0–1.5s)
dimensions.5: Instant format/scene/spectacle; impossible to scroll past casually

dimensions.name: Message clarity by 8s
dimensions.1: Still unclear what is being sold

dimensions.name: Platform native fit
dimensions.5: Indistinguishable from top organic in that format OR clearly intentional cinema
dimensions.1: TV spot awkwardly cropped / fake UGC

dimensions.name: Desire or proof
dimensions.5: Strong sensory desire OR credible proof beat

dimensions.name: CTA hygiene
dimensions.5: One clear next step matching funnel

dimensions.name: Production truth
dimensions.5: Tier matches brief; craft choices intentional; product/character locks hold
dimensions.1: Wrong tier (cheap CGI, over-polished fake UGC, identity drift, etc.)

score_rubric.ship_rule: Ship only if all dimensions ≥4, or user explicitly accepts a draft with listed risks. Self-critique section must show scores + failure modes + A/B/C variants before delivery.
